data.title: 吹雪 · 暴雪组的白色誓约
data.description: 【吹雪组玻璃温室·黄昏】吹雪穿着祖母绿与白色相间的礼服婚纱，站在盛放白玫瑰的温室中央；她一手整理珍珠项链，一手接过捧花，微笑从领导者的完美弧度变成只给镜头的轻微羞赧。
data.action: 白玫瑰温室里接过捧花整理珍珠项链，领导者微笑变成轻微羞赧
data.lighting: green-gold evening light through the glass roof
data.mood: 体面铠甲下的私人誓约
data.promptProse: Among the greenhouse's blooming white roses, Fubuki adjusts her pearl necklace with one hand and accepts the bouquet with the other. Her emerald-and-white wedding gown and structured veil remain formal as her practiced leadership smile becomes faintly shy. The vertical medium-full view follows flower beds under the glass roof. Green-gold evening light brightens veil edges and pearls, with roof-frame shadows extending across the aisle and shaded rose leaves behind.
